organization.title: Organizations
organization.helpDescription: Organizations help you manage access to projects. Each organization can have multiple projects and team members with different roles.

demo.demoDescription: We have built a Q&A chatbot that answers questions based on the Langfuse Docs. Interact with it to see traces in Langfuse.

onboarding.createOrgDescription: Create an organization to get started. Alternatively, ask your organization admin to invite you.
onboarding.needInviteDescription: You need to get invited to an organization to get started with Langfuse.
